text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka, boasting out-of-this-world speed.
As if inspired by her running...

From the younger generation, Umamusume possessing
speed worthy of a new era were rising rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaaan, I'm gonna
give it my aaaaaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Did you see that, Mama?!

—Special Week.
Silence Suzuka's junior roommate
conquered the Japan Derby.

The Twinkle Series grows ever more heated,
and the stage now shifts to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright, so you're running in this race too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Long time no see. And, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Suzuka said thank you...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because back during that 'Derby',
you showed everyone a run
that only you could deliver...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I've come to realize it.
That I, too, need to run the way I want to."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The person I was on that day wasn't the real me,
but today…… is the real me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can finally run with Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, Lady Suzuka. Likewise,
I am sooo very happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I accept your running head-on.
With dignity~. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing it.
A fresh new breath of life, distinct from the Mejiro way~.

A prelude to the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Yet this Takarazuka Kinen held
many other meanings as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can just run however you please, Suzuka.
I won't let you get away today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On my honor as the "Empress," I, Air Groove,
shall catch you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I won't push all the responsibility onto Bright.
If no one challenges her, she'll have an easy time out front. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll bell the cat and pass the baton to Bright.
No, if things go well, maybe even...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you've come, Dober. Show me whether
you possess the qualities of a queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, Air Groove-senpai. I will definitely blow you away!

The energy in the venue was extraordinary.
A heavens-shaking excitement reserved only for
races destined to go down in history.
A tangle of various rivalries intertwines. A fierce quartet resounds across Hanshin.
